name: @kickside/docscout-ui
title: Docscout
description: Configure document extractors and inspect extraction evidence.

entry-id.description: Id of the extractor component to manage, supplied by the workspace. Empty shows a message instead of an extractor.

wippy.description: Docscout extractor view for the workspace: Builder for fields and the reading flow, Test to run on an upload, Evals to measure accuracy against expected values, and Runs. The create view emits created with {id}; the page view emits navigate with its sub-path.
